craft_notes: Sthāyin: descent — apart, void, swoop, gleam. Rows: fall then gleam. Read aloud: falling then kindling.

lines: Sheer knowing sets a shape apart from knowns;
hemmed, hence going knowable: the void.
Then, free, swooping the thing with clutching zest,
filling the frame five-formed, it gleams as if awake.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃvid eva hi prameyebhyo vibhaktaṃ rūpaṃ gṛhṇāti ata eva ca avacchedayogāt vedyatāṃ yāntī nabhaḥ tataḥ svātantryāt meye svīkārautsukyena nipatantī kriyāśaktipradhānā prāṇanārūpā jīvasvabhāvā pañcabhī rūpaiḥ dehaṃ yataḥ pūrayati tato 'sau cetana iva bhāti
